title: Strengthening corporate governance: military experience on boards and audit quality in earnings management
core_idea: This study investigates how military-affiliated directors on corporate boards relate to accrual-based and real earnings management in non-financial firms listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange (2010–2022), and examines audit quality as a moderating factor, framed within upper echelons theory.
tldr: Examines the relationship between military experience on boards and accrual/real earnings management in Pakistani non-financial firms (2010–2022), and the moderating role of audit quality, to extend governance insights in an emerging-market context.
